page.overview:
Who is Dennis Nedry?

Dennis Theodore Nedry is the main antagonist during the first half of the original Jurassic Park film. He was a computer programmer at Jurassic Park. Due to his financial problems and low salary, he accepted a bribe from Biosyn to smuggle dinosaur embryos off the island.

In both the film and the novel, he is slain by a Dilophosaurus. He was directly responsible for the events that happened in both the novel and film. A combination of factors led to his demise: despite working in a career around dinosaurs and other prehistoric creatures, he had a limited knowledge of them, and greed, which was intertwined by desperation to pay off his debt collectors and make himself rich after that.

While a skilled technician, Dennis is a thickheaded, entitled, and inconsiderate man; he looks down on his co-workers and is despised by them as a result. In addition, he is also very slovenly and does not look after his workspace. His actions also show that he is willing to resort to illegal and unethical tactics when he feels wronged.

He is also indicated to have a very cynical view of other people, to the extent that was willing to risk exposing his involvement in a conspiracy in public. This was best demonstrated with his meeting with Dodgson at San Jose where Dodgson tried to tell him to keep quiet about the planned corporate espionage, particularly Dodgson involvement, lest it get leaked, with Nedry in response proceeding to loudly declare Dodgson presence, only to then tell Dodgson with the non-reaction by the public that they're safe since "no one cares".

Also known as: Nedry.
